api/admin-security.title: Admin Security API
api/admin-security.description: Use the Admin Security API to manage users, groups, passwords, group membership, and permission assignments.

api/agent-processes.title: Agent Processes API
api/agent-processes.description: Use the Agent Processes API to deploy reusable Agent Process definitions and retrieve the latest or versioned definitions by key.

api/ai-credentials.title: AI Credentials API
api/ai-credentials.description: Use the AI Credentials API to store provider credentials server-side and reference masked credential IDs from AI tasks.

api/authentication.title: Authentication API
api/authentication.description: Use the Authentication API to sign users in and inspect the current JWT session.

api/code-tasks.title: Code Tasks API
api/code-tasks.description: Use the Code Tasks API to upload JVM JARs, discover classes and methods, and inspect execution audit history.

api/documents.title: Documents API
api/documents.description: Use the Documents API to upload files, read metadata, preview, download, list, and delete task documents.

api/forms.title: Forms API
api/forms.description: Use the Forms API to deploy and retrieve versioned form definitions by stable form ID.

api/overview.title: API Overview
api/overview.description: This API reference is generated from the backend OpenAPI contract exposed at /v3/api-docs and enriched with DTO-based request and response examples from the Easy BPM backend controllers. The same contract powers Swagger UI at /swagger-ui.html.

api/processes.title: Processes API
api/processes.description: Use the Processes API to deploy definitions, start instances, manage variables, operate runtime state, and correlate messages.

api/schemas.title: Schemas
api/schemas.description: These schemas come from the backend OpenAPI components and the Kotlin DTOs that back the public API examples.

api/swagger.title: Swagger UI
api/swagger.description: The backend exposes interactive Swagger UI at:

api/tasks.title: Tasks API
api/tasks.description: Use the Tasks API to list visible work, claim shared tasks, inspect task context, and complete user tasks.

deployment/docker.title: Docker Deployment
deployment/docker.description: Docker Compose is the fastest way to run a complete Easy BPM stack for demos, pilots, and small beta environments.

deployment/kubernetes.title: Kubernetes Deployment
deployment/kubernetes.description: Easy BPM includes a Helm chart at deploy/helm/easybpm for Kubernetes deployments.

deployment/observability.title: Observability
deployment/observability.description: Easy BPM exposes Spring Boot Actuator endpoints and Prometheus metrics from the backend runtime.

getting-started/configuration.title: Configuration
getting-started/configuration.description: Easy BPM is configured with environment variables that follow the EASYBPM standard. Third-party container variables, such as POSTGRESDB, keep the names required by those images.

getting-started/first-login.title: First Login
getting-started/first-login.description: Easy BPM creates a first administrator user on startup. Use this account to sign in, create real customer users, and assign permissions.

getting-started/install.title: Installation
getting-started/install.description: Easy BPM can run as individual local processes during development or as containers for shared environments.

getting-started/quick-start.title: Quick Start
getting-started/quick-start.description: This guide starts Easy BPM locally with PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, the backend, the worker, and the web applications.

guides/api-tasks.title: API Tasks
guides/api-tasks.description: API Tasks call external HTTP services through the Easy BPM worker. They are useful for CRM calls, ERP updates, payment checks, webhook-style integrations, and private service orchestration.

guides/call-activities.title: Call Activities
guides/call-activities.description: Call Activities start another Easy BPM process as a subprocess. Use them when you want reusable process fragments such as KYC review, document verification, onboarding, or exception handling.

guides/code-tasks.title: Code Tasks
guides/code-tasks.description: Code Tasks execute Java or Kotlin code packaged in a JVM JAR. They are useful when a workflow needs customer-specific calculations, normalization, validation, enrichment, or deterministic business logic that should run inside the platform boundary.

guides/create-process.title: Create a Process
guides/create-process.description: An Easy BPM process is deployed as an Easy BPM process JSON graph. You can create it visually in the Modeler or send JSON directly to the /processes API.

guides/documents.title: Documents
guides/documents.description: Easy BPM stores documents uploaded through task forms or API calls. Metadata is returned through JSON endpoints, while file content is retrieved through download or preview endpoints.

guides/forms.title: Forms
guides/forms.description: Forms define the fields shown to users in the Task Portal. They are versioned by a stable formId, so a process can reference the latest deployed version without changing the process definition.

guides/message-events.title: Message Events
guides/message-events.description: Message events let external systems resume a waiting process by message name and correlation key.

guides/user-tasks.title: User Tasks
guides/user-tasks.description: User tasks create human work items that appear in the Task Portal.

intro.title: Welcome
intro.description: Easy BPM is a developer-friendly business process platform for modeling, running, and operating business workflows. It includes a process modeler, runtime API, task portal, admin console, asynchronous worker, document handling, code-task execution, and security administration.

platform/admin.title: Admin Console
platform/admin.description: The Admin Console is the operational workspace for process monitoring, instance intervention, user and group management, and Code Task audits.

platform/modeler.title: Modeler
platform/modeler.description: The Easy BPM Modeler is the workspace for designing process definitions and reusable forms. It has a component palette, a canvas, a properties panel, validation feedback, import/export actions, and deployment to the configured Easy BPM backend.

platform/task-portal.title: Task Portal
platform/task-portal.description: The Task Portal is where business users and developer testers start processes, view assigned work, claim group tasks, complete forms, upload documents, and preview PDFs.

reference/environment-variables.title: Environment Variables
reference/environment-variables.description: Use the EASYBPM naming standard for customer-facing configuration. Third-party container variables, such as POSTGRESDB, still use the names required by those images.

reference/examples.title: Examples
reference/examples.description: The public docs include copy-paste examples for the most common customer workflows.

reference/permissions.title: Permissions
reference/permissions.description: Easy BPM uses permission codes assigned directly to users or through groups.

reference/process-json.title: Process JSON Reference
reference/process-json.description: Easy BPM process definitions are JSON objects with processId, nodes, and flows.
